title: PGC Canonical Transport Response V0
description: Protocol-neutral canonical transport response contract (Transport Standard V0 §5.2). Representation-independent; JSON is one serialization and is not itself normative.

result_class.description: Governed, protocol-neutral Result Class. Carries no external-protocol semantics.

result.description: Projected result payload on success; null on failure.

authority.description: The authority from which this artifact's jurisdiction derives (CA-1, CA-2). Declared, never inferred from namespace, path or kind.

concern.description: The semantic subject this artifact is about (GO-11, ID-12). A concern classification confers no authority and constitutes no boundary.
